```{r}
#| label: inject-air-data
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
if (atmo_ready) {
  atmo_for_js <- atmo |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      code = code_commune, qual = qual_indice,
      qmean = qual_mean,
      no2 = no2_indice, o3 = o3_indice,
      pm10 = pm10_indice, pm25 = pm25_indice,
      n_days, pct_bon, pct_mauvais_plus,
      label = qual_label, source = source_aasqa,
      imputed = as.logical(imputed)
    )
  atmo_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(atmo_for_js, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")

  atmo_colors_js <- jsonlite::toJSON(as.list(.atmo_colors), auto_unbox = TRUE)
  atmo_labels_js <- jsonlite::toJSON(as.list(.atmo_labels), auto_unbox = TRUE)

  cat('<script>\n',
      'window.atmoRaw = ', as.character(atmo_json), ';\n',
      'window.atmoColors = ', as.character(atmo_colors_js), ';\n',
      'window.atmoLabels = ', as.character(atmo_labels_js), ';\n',
      'window.atmoNAColor = "#E8E4DC";\n',
      'window.atmoData = {};\n',
      'window.atmoRaw.forEach(function(r) { window.atmoData[r.code] = r; });\n',
      'window.atmoColorFor = function(v) {\n',
      '  if (v == null || v === undefined || v === "NA") return window.atmoNAColor;\n',
      '  return window.atmoColors[String(v)] || window.atmoNAColor;\n',
      '};\n',
      'window.atmoFieldMap = { "qual_indice":"qual", "no2_indice":"no2", "o3_indice":"o3", "pm10_indice":"pm10", "pm25_indice":"pm25" };\n',
      'window.atmoRecolor = function(pollutantCol) {\n',
      '  var map = window.atmoMap;\n',
      '  if (!map) return;\n',
      '  var key = window.atmoFieldMap[pollutantCol] || "qual";\n',
      '  map.eachLayer(function(layer) {\n',
      '    if (!layer.options || !layer.options.layerId) return;\n',
      '    var code = layer.options.layerId;\n',
      '    var ent = window.atmoData[code];\n',
      '    var v = ent ? ent[key] : null;\n',
      '    layer.setStyle({ fillColor: window.atmoColorFor(v), fillOpacity: (v == null ? 0.25 : 0.85) });\n',
      '  });\n',
      '};\n',
      'window.updateAirPanel = function(code) {\n',
      '  var el = document.getElementById("air-content");\n',
      '  if (!el) return;\n',
      '  var ent = window.atmoData[code];\n',
      '  var elec = window.communeLookup && window.communeLookup[code];\n',
      '  var nom = elec ? elec.nom_commune : code;\n',
      '  var dept = elec ? (elec.libelle_dept + " (" + elec.code_dept + ")") : "";\n',
      '  if (!ent) {\n',
      '    el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \'</div></div><div class="dvf-empty">Pas d\\u0027indice ATMO publié pour cette commune.</div>\';\n',
      '    return;\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  function pill(label, v) {\n',
      '    if (v == null) return "<div class=\\"atmo-row atmo-row-na\\"><span class=\\"atmo-pol\\">" + label + "</span><span class=\\"atmo-pill\\">—</span></div>";\n',
      '    var bg = window.atmoColors[String(v)];\n',
      '    var lib = window.atmoLabels[String(v)];\n',
      '    return "<div class=\\"atmo-row\\"><span class=\\"atmo-pol\\">" + label + "</span><span class=\\"atmo-pill\\" style=\\"background:" + bg + ";\\">" + v + " · " + lib + "</span></div>";\n',
      '  }\n',
      '  var impBadge = ent.imputed ? \'<span class="cp-badge cp-badge-imp" title="Pas de mesure publiée pour cette commune ; valeur = moyenne des communes mesurées du même département.">Estimation dept</span>\' : "";\n',
      '  function num(x, dec) { if (x == null) return "—"; return Number(x).toFixed(dec || 1); }\n',
      '  el.innerHTML = \'<div class="cp-header"><h3>\' + nom + \'</h3><div class="cp-meta">\' + dept + \' · \' + code + \' \' + impBadge + \'</div></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section">\' + pill("ATMO moyen 30j", ent.qual) + \'</div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section cp-kvs">\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Indice moyen</span><span class="cp-num">\' + num(ent.qmean, 1) + \' / 6</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>Jours observés</span><span class="cp-num">\' + (ent.n_days != null ? (ent.n_days + " / 30") : "—") + \'</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>% jours « Bon »</span><span class="cp-num">\' + num(ent.pct_bon, 1) + \'%</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-kv"><span>% jours « Mauvais+ »</span><span class="cp-num">\' + num(ent.pct_mauvais_plus, 1) + \'%</span></div>\' +\n',
      '    \'</div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section"><h4>Sous-indices polluants (moyenne 30j)</h4>\' +\n',
      '    pill("NO₂", ent.no2) + pill("O₃", ent.o3) + pill("PM₁₀", ent.pm10) + pill("PM₂.₅", ent.pm25) + \'</div>\' +\n',
      '    \'<div class="cp-section" style="font-size:0.78rem;color:#7A7A7A;">Source : \' + (ent.source || (ent.imputed ? "Imputée (moy. dépt)" : "—")) + \'</div>\';\n',
      '};\n',
      '</script>\n',
      sep = ""
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: map-air
if (atmo_ready) {
  m <- choropleth_atmo(com_metro_only, dep_metro, atmo, display_date = atmo_date)
  m |>
    htmlwidgets::onRender(
      sprintf(
        "function(el, x) {
           window.atmoMap = this;
           var self = this;
           function attach() {
             self.eachLayer(function(layer) {
               if (layer.options && layer.options.layerId && !layer._atmoClickOn) {
                 layer._atmoClickOn = true;
                 layer.on('click', function(e) {
                   var code = e.target.options.layerId;
                   if (window.updateAirPanel) window.updateAirPanel(code);
                 });
               }
             });
           }
           self._cpReattach = attach;
           setTimeout(attach, 60);
           setTimeout(attach, 500);
           setTimeout(attach, 2000);
           self.on('layeradd', function() { setTimeout(attach, 0); });
           function readSel() {
             var p = document.querySelector('input[name=atmo-pol]:checked');
             return p ? p.value : 'qual_indice';
           }
           function onChange() {
             var pol = readSel();
             if (window.atmoRecolor) window.atmoRecolor(pol);
           }
           setTimeout(function() {
             document.querySelectorAll('input[name=atmo-pol]')
               .forEach(function(r) { r.addEventListener('change', onChange); });
           }, 300);
         }"
      )
    )
} else {
  htmltools::HTML(
    "<p style='padding:2rem;color:#7A7A7A;'>",
    "Air non chargé. Lancer<br><code>Rscript scripts/04_air_atmo.R</code>",
    "</p>"
  )
}
```
